card.name: Just before reconstitution or vial puncture
card.fires_on: The word or word start just before an expected "constitution" or a vial-opening verb, such as "re" in reconstitution, or "is", "was" or "been" after container closure or vial. It appears in pharmacy preparation and in-use time limit instructions.

modes.label: Start of reconstitution
modes.description: The "re" that begins "reconstitution" after words like after, following or in the.

modes.label: Verb after vial or closure
modes.description: A linking verb after closure or vial that leads to penetrated, opened or spiked.
modes.example: within 4 hours after the container closure<< is>> penetrated.

card.writes: It seems to push toward the word "cell" or "cells", which is an odd effect with little link to the visible text.
card.plain: It lights up on the small word just before text about mixing up or puncturing a vial, as in time limits after reconstitution.
